comment: The nine modules that lived in the skeleton now live in the base modules, and four submodules have repositories of their own. Run on a build installed from a fresh checkout with --recurse-submodules, through sara_door.py --build, so every module here came through the new submodules. The Exposure and Sphere dockers open, a box blur is applied to a painted layer, the drifting sky is added from the layers docker's Add menu, a lesson of the tutorials plays, and Czech is picked in Preferences.
The two dockers from the base modules' exposure and sphere folders.
A filled layer and the box blur from the base modules' box-blur folder.
The drifting sky from the Add menu of the layers docker.
A lesson of the tutorials, from Help.
Czech, from the language module, picked on the Languages page.
